title: Would Not Recommend
text:
I've had insurance coverage with Pumpkin for almost a year, and while the policy looks comprehensive on paper, my actual experience has been frustrating and extremely disappointing.

My biggest issue has been Pumpkin’s denial of a claim for what they labeled a “pre-existing condition.” My dog was seen by her veterinarian for a respiratory issue and underwent diagnostic testing to determine the cause. Although she had experienced a similar respiratory issue in the past, that issue had fully resolved on its own. According to my policy, any condition that has been cured and free of symptoms or treatment for 180 days should not be considered pre-existing, and my dog clearly met that requirement.

Despite this, Pumpkin denied the claim. I was told I could appeal the decision and that my veterinarian could clarify in the medical records that the prior respiratory issue had resolved. I did exactly that and submitted an appeal with updated clinic notes. The appeal was denied anyway. Pumpkin completely ignored both my explanation and my vet’s updated notes and continued to rely on outdated records.

I attempted to submit a second appeal, which Pumpkin initially refused to accept. At that point, I contacted the California Department of Insurance for assistance. This prompted Pumpkin to conduct a third review, but the outcome was the same. Once again, they ignored the facts, my statements, and my veterinarian’s updated clinical notes, and continued to deny the claim based on the same old information.

This entire process was exhausting, stressful, and incredibly discouraging. It has left me worried that my dog will not receive the coverage she needs if other health issues arise in the future.

My second major issue is the outrageous renewal increase. My premium is going up by 59%. This kind of increase is unreasonable—especially when Pumpkin has already shown they are unwilling to cover significant health issues. At this point, I am seriously questioning whether it’s worth continuing my policy with them.

Overall, I am extremely dissatisfied and would not consider myself a happy customer.

title: I’m extremely disappointed with Pumpkin…
text:
I’I’m extremely disappointed with Pumpkin Pet Insurance and would not
recommend them to other pet owners.

I brought my cat to the vet after he threw up one time. My vet performed blood work, monitored him, and cleared him — nothing serious or chronic was found. One time.

My cat threw up several times and became dehydrated.  We had to take him to emergency room after seeing his vet to get fluids.  Despite this, Pumpkin denied the  entire claim, stating that the issue was considered a pre-existing
condition.
  
This is extremely frustrating because my cat was evaluated by a
licensed veterinarian and medically cleared with no ongoing condition, yet Pumpkin still refused coverage. If a single incident of vomiting
can be twisted into a reason to deny legitimate care, then what are you really paying for?

I get pet insurance for peace of mind, not to fight over basic emergency care when something unexpected happens. Instead of support
during a stressful moment with my pet, I was left dealing with paperwork, excuses, and a denial.

Save your money and look elsewhere — when it actually matters, they won’t be there for you
